versions.changelog:
Initial release of the APIDot Happy Horse 1.1 API skill.

- Provides documentation-only guidance for integrating APIDot Happy Horse 1.1 workflows.
- Includes routing to relevant docs, model pages, webhooks, and API examples.
- No executable code or automated API calls; credentials are not stored.
- Comprehensive guidance on async workflow, task status polling, and webhook integration.
- Emphasizes API key security and directs users to official APIDot resources.
